selection.ownership: Bidsketch, a bootstrapped US SaaS founded by Ruben Gamez (2009), with public company identity in Portland / Clackamas, Oregon. The reviewed edition is the public international API at https://bidsketch.com/api/v1, not a mainland-China product.

research.searchCoverage: Official BidSketch API v1 (Authorization Token token="...", GET /proposals/stats.json, GET /clients.json, GET /clients/{id}.json, GET /proposals.json, GET /proposals/{id}.json), help article for API tokens, Bidsketch Oregon/US identity, and dated incident search for BidSketch / Bidsketch / Docsketch security breach/incident reviewed on 2026-09-13. Docsketch 2020 database copy access is a sibling e-sign product by the same founder, not the BidSketch proposal API. Sketch.com May 2025 crash-log incident is an unrelated Mac design app. No qualifying current unresolved BidSketch customer-credential compromise identified; this is not a breach-free claim.

Official BidSketch HTTP API at https://bidsketch.com/api/v1 with Token token= authentication (quoted token, matching official README and pinned runtime), GET /proposals/stats.json as the cheap account stats read used by the pinned credential validator, client and proposal list/get reads, Oregon/US identity, and dated 2026-09-13 incident search. Docsketch 2020 is a sibling e-sign brand, not this API. No current unresolved BidSketch customer-credential compromise identified. Bounded coverage is not a breach-free claim.

incidents.affectedProduct: Docsketch (sibling e-sign product founded by Ruben Gamez; not BidSketch)
incidents.affectedData: Unauthorized access to a 2020-07-09 database copy containing contact information, form fields, login information, and user contacts. Documents themselves were not accessed.
incidents.status: historical sibling-product incident; distinguished from BidSketch proposal API
incidents.remediation: Docsketch reported the system secured and infrastructure updated after the August 2020 intrusion; customers notified.
incidents.residualRisk: Not a BidSketch API compromise. Historical non-China incident retained under the 2026-09-13 waiver.

research.waiverAuthority: User waiver dated 2026-09-13 permits historical non-China incident coverage.

adaptations: Credential-only healthcheck maps to documented GET /proposals/stats.json used by the pinned credential validator, not a billed lookup. Native omits the upstream User-Agent. Native category is productivity rather than Productivity/Marketing.
Official GET /clients.json with optional page and per_page. Input perPage maps to query per_page as in pinned runtime. List body is a JSON array under data.
Official GET /clients/{id}.json. clientId is a required positive integer path segment.
Official GET /proposals.json with optional page and per_page. Writes, client-scoped proposal lists, and proposal content are omitted.
Official GET /proposals/{id}.json. proposalId is a required positive integer path segment.
Official POST /clients.json. firstName/lastName/email map to first_name/last_name/email.
Official PUT /clients/{id}.json. Omitted optional fields are dropped from the JSON body.
Official DELETE /clients/{id}.json returns 204. Mapped to {deleted,id}.
Official GET /clients/{id}/proposals.json.
Official POST /proposals.json. clientId maps to client_id.
Official PUT /proposals/{id}.json.
Official DELETE /proposals/{id}.json returns 204. Mapped to {deleted,id}.
Official GET /proposals/{id}/content.json with nested sections and fees.
Official GET /fees.json with optional page and per_page.
Official GET /fees/{id}.json.
Official POST /fees.json. feeType maps to feetype.
Official GET /sections.json with optional page and per_page.
Official GET /sections/{id}.json.
Official GET /templates.json.
Official GET /templates/{id}.json.
